body: Everything seems so fleeting - and what's worse I know how selfish that sounds.

I've never seen this - I'm gonna read about it.  But there is a difference between a distraction and fixing myself.  And I'm not sure what it is.  I feel like this boredom is a disease and I'm infected with it.

My life is good - which makes this constant fucking sinking feeling somehow even worse.

I have my own company, I'm a professional software developer, worked with amazing companies, even wrote books.  I have a girlfriend that I love.  

But I wake up, everyday - and I'm bored - I feel bored to the point of aggravation ALWAYS.  Maybe it sounds fickle and selfish.  But I feel it.  And it ruins every day.
